kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أخضوضب (form XII)
# أَخْضَوْضِبُ (ʔaḵḍawḍibu) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# أَخْضَوْضِبَ (ʔaḵḍawḍiba) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# أَخْضَوْضِبْ (ʔaḵḍawḍib) /ʔax.dˤaw.dˤib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
